# E1/E3 Slice T — change list (GENERATED by docs/review/e1e3_sliceT_build.mjs from the 2026-10-29 live captures)

| object | before (live) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `training_sessions` columns | 21 columns (`duration_min smallint` = the length the ledger reads) | + `actual_start time`, `actual_end time`, `setup_min smallint` (nullable) |
| CHECKs | 8 constraints (incl. `training_sessions_duration_range` 1–1440) | + `training_sessions_actual_pair`, `training_sessions_actual_whole_minutes`, `training_sessions_actual_length`, `training_sessions_setup_range` |

| `finalize_training_session(uuid, time, time, integer)` | — | **new**: SECURITY DEFINER, `search_path=public`, EXECUTE authenticated + service_role only |
| `correct_training_session(…)` | md5 `ec6b3c29d4cf472527ec84f948b84b88` | + keys `actual_start`, `actual_end`, `setup_min`; length recomputed from the times; a disagreeing length refused (ACL kept) |
| `tg_training_session_lock_guard()` | md5 `47918d20ab527240e54360eacca00cac` | + the three columns: set once at Finalize, Correct-only after (ACL kept) |
| `attested_training` / `dept_iso_hours_for` | `aff25333771cd38c1f473bcde5e1e96e` / `705c9a9b5532d28824f5e50e74d6059f` | **unchanged** — pinned; per-department output proven byte-identical |

The span formula, used by the CHECK and both RPCs: `((extract(epoch from (end - start)) / 60)::integer + case when end <= start then 1440 else 0 end)`. An end at or before the start ran past midnight.
